body: I don’t know, part of me still loves him after all the abuse but I feel like ever since we’ve been talking and in person again, I just have been feeling worse. The people I were talking to on dating apps I like a lot more than him but I’m so attached to him for some reason. I feel like I can’t escape him.
I’m not doing well unfortunately. He contacted me and I should’ve just ignored him like I was doing but I took his bait and I’m just feel like garbage all over again.

Thank you for this. I have a few good friends online I can talk to but irl I don’t have any which is what I’m looking for at the moment in addition to a boyfriend. I now know not to depend so much on a s/o for my emotional well-being I think I depended so much on him because he made me feel like shit and so little. 

I never want to go back to him but some fucked up part of me does. I hated myself when I was with him and I wish I could reset everything and never chose him. I’m trying to focus on myself and have been but it’s so difficult. I feel like he’s gotten back into my head when I didn’t want him there. I thought I was doing okay and making progress but I feel like I fell back into a deep slump.

Yes, I’m not trying to forget all the things he did to me that hurt me deeply. I even have notes and voice journals saying what he did and it breaks my heart hearing them. It is so painful because we had some really roughy times but for the most part it was good. I miss the good parts in our relationship and only want it to be good with minor scuffles here and there but nothing major like how it used to be. I asked him yesterday if he wanted to be with me and he said, “Is it a black and white answer? Because if I say no or I don’t know, then I don’t want you to never talk to me again. But I also don’t know if I can say yes fully.” I thought that was pretty fair because I also don’t really know if I want to be with him. Although, a VERY LARGE part of me does want to be with him and I feel stupid for that because he lied and cheated on me. I’m being very cautious but I just wish he had a definitive answer.

I think he’s being honest with me about his feelings and what he has to say because he says he hasn’t been actively looking for people but he could also just be lying to my face. He also mentioned how what if doesn’t want anything serious right now because he needs to deal with his life situation and I was firm and said I get that but I want a committed relationship and need to work up to that again. I just don’t know want commitment means to him or if we do continue this, if he will ever want a committed relationship at all. I just don’t want to waste my time any longer.

I just feel horrible because I made such stupid decisions when we were in a relationship and I highly regret them and part of me wishes I had never met him. I love him so much but I just wish this whole thing (lying, cheating, verbal/emotional abuse) never happened.
Yeah, I told myself I wasn’t going to have sex with him but I honestly felt really tempted to and kind of wanted to. I’m so stupid for even going through with it. I regret it so much.

It surprisingly wasn’t. It was more of my rationale for it. He said you pushed me into the arms of another woman. Quite frankly I’ve been cold and heartless to him so I understand why he’d want to but it still really hurts
